description: Creates a free online sign-up / registration form on Tickmi and returns a link to share plus a private manage link to see responses and download Excel. A required "Full name" question is always added first; add up to 9 more questions (text, long text, phone, email, single choice). Use when the user wants to collect registrations or simple answers. Deleted 30 days after the last edit.

description.description: Short intro shown above the questions.

language.description: Language of the page shown to participants: vi (Vietnamese) or en (English).

questions.description: Questions besides the automatic Full name. Up to 9.

options.description: Choices, required when type is select.

type.description: text = short answer, textarea = long answer, select = pick one of options.

name: create_form

expires_at.description: ISO time when the tool is deleted if not edited again.

manage_url.description: Private link for the creator to see results and edit. Keep it secret.

studio_import_url.description: invite only: opens Tickmi Studio to turn the card into an event with RSVP and QR check-in.

view_url.description: Link to share with participants (or to open the tool).

title: Create a sign-up form
